data.rationale: The proposal gets the core hotel search flow right (destination, dates, rooms/guests, search), but it omits the filter and sort step (Distance, Price low to high), adds children and child-age parameters that the true workflow doesn't have, and gives vague step details, so a browser automation would need guesswork.
